011e8a6b51807e2a.desc: Tuesday – Friday, 10am – 3pm, Guided Tours (groups of 5 or more) and Self-guided Visits Saturday, 10am – 2pm, Self-guided Visits Only* Discover the fascinating world of birds at the Western Foundation of Vertebrate Zoology, also known as the Camarillo Bird Museum! Explore some of the world’s largest collection of eggs, nests and other specimens while learning about bird species, habitats, and the research that helps advance our understanding of avian life. Whether you’re a bird enthusiast or simply curious, a tour offers a closer look at the beauty, diversity, and science of the bird world.

01d3d052cf041792.title: LEGO® Club — Drop in and build!
01d3d052cf041792.desc: Families and kids are invited to come build and create. Become an engineer, design a city, build a boat, a dream house, or a space ship. Drop in and design your own masterpiece using the Library's LEGO bricks. Get creative and have fun. We also provide larger Duplo blocks for younger children. When engaging in building activities children can be as adventurous and creative as they want, allowing them to experiment, problem solve, and test out new ideas. Playing with LEGO® bricks is also known to have benefits for the development of fine motor skills, developing dexterity and strength in the fingers. The differing amounts of pressure required to assemble the bricks is a great exercise for fingers, supporting children in being able to hold a pencil and control the pressure applied when writing.

019d0b320f1cf332.title: Renee Safier & Bob Malone At the Grand Annex
019d0b320f1cf332.desc: Grand Annex favorites Bob Malone and Renee Safier join forces for a night of classic jazz and blues standards. Renee is an award-winning versatile rock, blues, and jazz vocalist. Known best for her work with Andy Hill and their band Hard Rain, Safier has played her guitar and sung her heart out to devoted folk-rock fans for decades. Bob Malone is known for his high-energy piano-playing hybrid of rock, pop, and blues. He’s has toured with John Fogerty since 2011, done session work with Ringo Starr and Avril Lavigne and has amassed his own a loyal fan-base through 25 years of touring and nine critically acclaimed albums. The New Yorker called Bob, a “keyboard wizard” and in 2018, his recording of “You’re A Mean One, Mr. Grinch” was featured in the trailer for the Illumination/Universal film, The Grinch.
